system.description:
You breathe a twisted semblance of life into a person's shadow, raising a dark mannequin that serves you loyally for the span of its brief existence.

Win a Static Mental Challenge against a nine-Trait difficulty and spend one or more Blood Traits. The target's shadow animates for one hour per Blood Trait spent, but never past the next sunrise. It has all of its parent's Physical, Social, Mental and Ability Traits plus six Health Levels (all Bruised for wound penalties), and may invoke Shadow Play for the cost of one Mental Trait. It may move no more than 50 feet from its parent, though it can flatten to two dimensions to slide up walls or under doors. In combat it takes half damage from physical attacks and double from supernatural attacks, fire and sunlight; if it dies, its parent loses one Willpower Trait. You may animate a maximum number of Shadow Twins per night equal to your Morality Traits.
system.duration: 1 hour per Blood Trait spent, max until sunrise
